title: Instagram DMs and WhatsApp chats in one list.
lede: Stop switching apps mid-sale. Every DM, story reply and WhatsApp chat lands in one list, each marked with the app it came from, and you can sort it by who's closest to converting.

pillars.title: See the buyers before the spam
pillars.text: When someone sends a 🔥 on your story, SellThinker tucks it out of the way. When someone asks “Is this still available?”, it stays front and centre.

pillars.title: Reply on the app the buyer used
pillars.text: Each chat shows whether it came from Instagram or WhatsApp, and your reply goes back the same way. Nothing to copy between apps.

pillars.title: Made for the person answering the chats
pillars.text: SellThinker is built to be run by whoever answers your chats: you, the people who sell alongside you, or a fulfilment partner you work with.

steps.title: Connect both apps
steps.text: Instagram with Meta's official login. WhatsApp through Meta's business platform, and where Meta allows it, you keep using the app on your phone.

steps.title: Your chats come in
steps.text: Recent chats come in first. New messages arrive with their stage and score already attached.

steps.title: Reply where it suits you
steps.text: Reply from SellThinker or from your phone. Either way, the chat stays up to date.

outcomes.text: No more switching between Instagram and WhatsApp during a busy launch hour.
No more “I missed that DM” because it was in the other app.
See every buyer still waiting on you, oldest first.
An easier way to spot and select the conversations that matter.

faq.question: Will this replace Instagram and WhatsApp on my phone?
faq.answer: No. SellThinker works alongside them. Messages you send from your phone show up in SellThinker too.

faq.question: What about story replies and reactions?
faq.answer: If a story reply asks something or mentions a product, it's ranked and sorted like any other chat. If it's spam or a random reaction, it's tucked away and marked low priority.

faq.question: Will a buyer who's waiting get missed?
faq.answer: No. There's a list of every chat where the buyer spoke last, oldest wait first, so nobody sits unanswered without you knowing.

faq.question: Do I need the WhatsApp Business API?
faq.answer: You need a WhatsApp Business number connected through Meta's platform. We walk you through it, and where Meta's coexistence is available, the WhatsApp Business app on your phone keeps working. Our onboarding specialists will help you set up the full sync when you sign up.

title: Know where every chat stands, without re-reading it.
lede: SellThinker analyses each chat and sorts it into conversation stages: sales, support, business and more, with every sales chat tracked through ready to close, payment sent, going quiet, closed or lost. It updates on its own and uses niche-specific formulas, so it understands the conversations unique to your business.

pillars.title: Contextualised across every message
pillars.text: A stage shows where the conversation is now, not where it was this morning. Every new message is read against everything said before it, so when a quiet buyer writes “sending UPI now”, the chat moves to Ready to close straight away.

pillars.title: Transparent reasoning, adjustable to you
pillars.text: See the buyer's words behind each stage. If one is wrong, correct it through your own preferences. As you do, SellThinker learns from them and adapts its algorithm.

pillars.title: Sales and other chats, kept separate
pillars.text: A delivery complaint, a collab pitch or a friend saying hi isn't a sale, so it's sorted into its own stage instead of cluttering your sales list.

steps.title: Detect
steps.text: Each new message runs through intent and lifecycle classifiers in well under a second.

steps.title: Assign
steps.text: Custom parameters give each conversation a stage and a confidence score. Hover to see the cues behind it.

steps.title: Override and adapt
steps.text: As you adjust your parameters and scoring, SellThinker's sales intelligence adapts to your preferences.

howNote: SellThinker uses a proprietary sales analysis engine that tunes itself by understanding your business in depth.

outcomes.text: You know what a chat needs before you scroll up.
You always know which chat needs you next.
No more re-reading 30 chats at 9 PM.
Your sales channels move to a system that adapts to you.

faq.question: What are the stages?
faq.answer: Sales chats move through browsing, needs a reply, ready to close, payment sent, going quiet, closed and lost. Chats that aren't sales, like support, business or personal messages, get their own stage and are kept apart from your sales list.

faq.question: What if it gets a stage wrong?
faq.answer: Correct it in one tap. SellThinker records the correction, learns from your preferences and adapts how it reads your chats.

faq.question: Can I add my own stages?
faq.answer: Not yet. A fixed set keeps your priority list and follow-ups reliable.

title: Open the chats that matter most first.
lede: Every morning, Priority Today puts the most important chats in front of you, so you know which WhatsApp or Instagram thread to reply to first. No scrolling, no guessing, no “87 unread” panic.

pillars.title: Ready to pay comes first
pillars.text: The order is simple. Buyers ready to pay come first (Close), then customers with a problem (Protect), then business messages, then buyers going quiet (Rescue), then everyone else waiting on a reply.

pillars.title: Niche-specific scoring
pillars.text: SellThinker is the only DM management software that adapts to your niche and understands what matters most for your type of business. It's also the only one you can tailor to your own priorities, so the order fits how you sell.

pillars.title: Every chat says why it's there
pillars.text: Data points like “confirmed size and asked to pay” or “second message about a refund” tell you why each chat made the list.

steps.title: Your list is ready
steps.text: When you open SellThinker, today's list is already built from every chat with something waiting.

steps.title: Work through it in order
steps.text: Open the first chat, reply or send the link, and move to the next.

steps.title: It keeps up
steps.text: Chats you've answered drop off. A buyer who says they're ready to pay moves up.

howNote: SellThinker runs a custom analysis every morning that scores and sorts your chats based on what's important to you.

outcomes.text: No more mornings spent deciding where to start.
Buyers ready to pay stop slipping past “I'll get to it later”.
Your day has a finish line.
A better understanding of your high-priority leads.

faq.question: How many chats are on the list?
faq.answer: Up to 25, so the list stays something you can actually finish. Everything else is still waiting in your inbox, sorted and scored, for when you have time.

faq.question: What if I want to see everything?
faq.answer: Every chat is still in your inbox, sorted however you like. Priority Today is a shortlist of the chats that need you most today, not a limit on what you can see.

faq.question: Why is a complaint above a warm lead?
faq.answer: A paying customer with an unanswered problem can cost you more than a new sale: a bad review, a refund, or a buyer who never comes back. So Protect sits near the top, and SellThinker always keeps it in the top two groups.

faq.question: Can I hide a chat for now?
faq.answer: Yes. Snooze a buyer until a date, like the day a restock lands, or until they write to you again. They leave your list until then, and come back when you have a real reason to reply.

faq.question: Can I adjust my Priority Today parameters?
faq.answer: Yes. SellThinker lets you tailor Priority Today to what you think matters most in your DMs. In Settings you can change the order the groups are worked in and adjust how hot and warm are set, and you can preview today's list before you save. The one fixed rule: a paying customer waiting on you stays in the top two.

title: Know which chat is closest to paying.
lede: Every sales chat gets a score from 0 to 100. The higher the score, the hotter the lead and the better its chance of converting. The score combines what the buyer says with a custom algorithm that analyses your industry and your business.

pillars.title: Hot, warm, cold, at a glance
pillars.text: Hot (70+) means they're close to buying. Warm (40–69) is interested. Cold (under 40) can wait. The badge sits on every sales chat.

pillars.title: Built from the buyer's words
pillars.text: Asking the price, how to pay or for the link raises the score. Size, colour and stock questions raise it too. Doubts and “maybe later” lower it.

pillars.title: Cools when a chat goes quiet
pillars.text: A hot chat that goes silent drops over time. When the buyer writes again, it warms back up.

pillars.title: An algorithm built for your business
pillars.text: SellThinker's proprietary scoring sets its calculations around your industry, location, language and audience, which makes your lead scores far more accurate.

steps.title: Read
steps.text: Every message in a sales chat is checked for buying signals as it arrives.

steps.title: Score
steps.text: The chat gets a score from 0 to 100, and a hot, warm or cold badge.

steps.title: Explain
steps.text: Tap the score to see which of the buyer's words raised or lowered it.

outcomes.text: You know who's ready to buy before you open the chat.
Hot chats come with the reason, not just a number.
Your priority list and follow-ups use the same score, so they always agree.
Onboarding includes an analysis of your business, so scoring is accurate and relevant for your industry.

faq.question: What counts toward the score?
faq.answer: Two things work together. First, SellThinker's own algorithm, set up for your business during onboarding, decides how much each signal is worth in your industry. Then it reads the buyer's signals: buying language (price, how to pay, the link), product detail (size, colour, stock), how recent the chat is, and past orders once your store's orders are connected. A buyer who says they bought elsewhere drops to 0.

faq.question: Is it per chat or per person?
faq.answer: Per chat. Each sales conversation gets its own score.

faq.question: Does a score go down?
faq.answer: Yes. Quiet time cools a score, and a buyer writing again warms it back up.

faq.question: What if a buyer uses two handles?
faq.answer: They stay as two buyers. SellThinker won't guess that an Instagram handle and a WhatsApp number are the same person, because a wrong match would mix up two strangers' chats.

faq.question: Can a buyer ask for their data to go?
faq.answer: Yes. Buyer-requested deletion removes the profile and everything chat-derived within 24 hours. Built to DPDP and GDPR standards.

title: Recover leads before they're cold.
lede: A buyer asks the price, then stops replying. SellThinker spots the silence, shows the most likely reason, and drafts a follow-up that fits it while they're still deciding. You choose whether to send it.

pillars.title: Custom recovery for each reason
pillars.text: A price worry, a delivery question, not sure they can trust you, trouble paying. SellThinker analyses why each lead dropped off and gives you a next step built for that reason.

pillars.title: Timed to your shop
pillars.text: It starts from the usual pace for your kind of shop. After 30 replies from 10 of your buyers, it switches to your own buyers' rhythm, and shows you which one it's using.

pillars.title: Knows when to stop
pillars.text: Instagram and WhatsApp limit when and how a business can message a buyer. SellThinker knows those messaging windows and template limits, and won't suggest a direct reply once a window has closed. It also stops suggesting after two follow-ups.

pillars.title: Snooze for the right day
pillars.text: Restock next week? Snooze the buyer until then, and they come back to your list when you have a real reason to write.

steps.title: Spot
steps.text: Every hour, SellThinker checks for buyers who went quiet.

steps.title: Explain
steps.text: Each one gets a likely reason, based on what they last said.

steps.title: Suggest
steps.text: You get a drafted follow-up that fits the reason. Edit it, send it, or skip it.

howNote: Lead recovery pulls chat data from your unified inbox to find the best opportunities that can still be turned into sales.

outcomes.text: Fewer buyers lost to a silence you didn't notice.
No more awkward “just checking in” messages.
Your buyers feel remembered, not chased.
See how many quiet buyers came back each week.

faq.question: Will I bother buyers with too many messages?
faq.answer: No. After two follow-ups, SellThinker stops suggesting more, unless the buyer writes again.

faq.question: Can I write my own message?
faq.answer: Of course. The draft is a starting point. Change it, or write your own.

faq.question: What if they've bought somewhere else?
faq.answer: If a buyer says they've bought elsewhere, the chat is marked lost and they're left alone.

faq.question: Does anything send automatically?
faq.answer: No. Every follow-up stays a draft until you send it.

title: Your products, plus the words buyers actually use.
lede: SellThinker syncs directly with your e-commerce catalog and picks up the phrases your customers use, like “the ivory one” or “that blush dress from the reel”, mapping each one to the actual product. When it isn't sure, it asks you.
pillarsLabel: What makes the SellThinker catalog different

pillars.title: Learns your buyers' words
pillars.text: When a buyer's phrase doesn't match a product, SellThinker saves it as a suggestion. Approve it once, and the next buyer who says it is matched.

pillars.title: Asks instead of guessing
pillars.text: If two products could fit, it asks you. A wrong match means a wrong payment link, so it never guesses.

pillars.title: Full catalog sync
pillars.text: SellThinker syncs directly with your product catalog, whether it's on Shopify, WooCommerce or a spreadsheet you upload as a CSV, pulling in stock, sizes, variants and more. So its recommendations are based on real product information.

pillars.title: Shows what buyers keep asking for
pillars.text: See which phrases match nothing in your catalog and how many chats asked, so a gap becomes a buying decision.

steps.title: Import
steps.text: Connect your preferred catalog or e-commerce system to sync your products directly with SellThinker.

steps.title: Match
steps.text: Product mentions in chats are matched to your catalog as they arrive.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.text: New phrases wait for your one-tap approval. Nothing is approved automatically.

steps.title: Reuse
steps.text: Matched products show up in drafts and follow-ups, so you name the exact piece the buyer asked about.

outcomes.text: Find the right product in seconds, even at midnight.
Follow-ups name the exact piece a buyer asked about.
Fewer wrong payment links.
See demand for things you don't sell yet.

faq.question: Do I need to add products to SellThinker by hand?
faq.answer: No. SellThinker syncs automatically with the e-commerce system you already use, like Shopify or WooCommerce, so your products, prices and stock come in on their own. No online store? Upload a CSV file instead.

faq.question: What about variants and colours?
faq.answer: Supported. A phrase can point to a product or to a specific variant, like “Blue / Large”.

faq.question: Who approves new phrases?
faq.answer: You do, with one tap. Nothing is approved automatically.

faq.question: Will it change my store?
faq.answer: Never. Store connections only read. Nothing goes back.

title: Works with the apps you do business with.
lede: SellThinker is engineered to fit into the business stack you already run, from Instagram DMs and WhatsApp to your product catalog and payment links, so every chat carries the product, the stock and the next step. No migration, and nothing new to learn.

pillars.title: Keep the WhatsApp Business app on your phone
pillars.text: With Meta's coexistence, the WhatsApp Business app and SellThinker share one number, so you keep replying from your phone. Meta asks you to open the app about every 13 days, and groups don't sync. If coexistence isn't available for your number yet, you can connect a new one.

pillars.title: Instagram, with Meta's official login
pillars.text: Connect your Instagram professional account in one step. Bots and automations you already run, like ManyChat, keep running as they are.

pillars.title: Your store stays in charge
pillars.text: Shopify, WooCommerce, a CSV file, or products added by hand. Prices and stock come in; SellThinker never changes your store.

pillars.title: Your own payment links, in the reply
pillars.text: SellThinker never handles payments. You keep your own payment provider, like Razorpay, Stripe or your UPI ID, and SellThinker only connects to it to put your payment link in the reply. The money goes straight to you.

steps.title: Connect
steps.text: Log in to each app once.

steps.title: Read together
steps.text: Each message is matched to its product, stock and payment details as it arrives.

steps.title: Work as usual
steps.text: Use SellThinker as your main dashboard, with each app feeding in its own data, so you never have to switch between them.

outcomes.text: One place to see every buyer, without switching apps.
Keep your habits. Nothing to relearn.
Drafts quote your real stock and prices.

faq.question: Do I have to stop using WhatsApp on my phone?
faq.answer: Usually not. Where Meta's coexistence is available, the WhatsApp Business app keeps working as it does today, and SellThinker reads alongside.

faq.question: Will it change anything in my store?
faq.answer: No. Store connections only read. Prices and stock come in; nothing goes back.

faq.question: I use ManyChat. Does that break?
faq.answer: No. Your flows keep running. SellThinker reads the same chats, so you can see where a person should step in.

faq.question: Can I export my data?
faq.answer: Yes. Export your chats as a CSV file any time.

faq.question: Does it connect to a CRM?
faq.answer: Not today. SellThinker isn't a CRM, and most chat shops don't need one. Export a CSV file if you want your data somewhere else. We do plan to add CRM connections as SellThinker grows into a full DM management tool, shaped by your feedback.

title: Get complete analytics and a full report of your chat sales.
lede: Every buying chat ends up closed, saved or lost. SellThinker counts what happened, shows why sales slipped, and links you straight to the chats and screens where you can fix it.

pillars.title: One report, three time frames
pillars.text: Switch between Today, Week and Month. Today updates live as chats close. Weekly reports are saved every Monday morning and monthly ones on the 1st, in your timezone, and you can step back through past periods.

pillars.title: Closed, saved and lost, counted honestly
pillars.text: See how many chats closed, how many quiet buyers came back and bought, and how many said no. A chat that only went quiet isn't counted as lost, and each number is compared with the period before.

pillars.title: Why sales slipped, not just how many
pillars.text: Buyers who went quiet are grouped by cause, like a missed question, price talk, an unpaid link, a delivery worry or a trust doubt, and each cause points to the place you fix it.

pillars.title: Honest about money and early days
pillars.text: Sales are valued at your catalog prices and marked as an estimate, never as money received, because SellThinker never sees your payments. Below about 20 sales chats, it tells you it's too early instead of guessing.

steps.title: Live today
steps.text: Today's closes, saved buyers and losses update as chats close.

steps.title: Saved every week
steps.text: Every Monday morning, last week's report is saved in your timezone and compared with the week before.

steps.title: Rolled up every month
steps.text: On the 1st, the month's report adds week-by-week trends and a full products table.

howNote: Reports are worked out on their own and saved once, so a finished week's numbers never change.

outcomes.text: Know how your week went in a minute.
Fix the leak that happens most, not the one you remember.
See next week whether the fix worked.

viewsLabel: Seven views of your chat sales
viewsLede: Each one answers a single question, and each says what it found in plain words.

views.title: Report
views.text: Closed, saved and lost, when you sold, your buyer funnel from new chat to paid, and one thing SellThinker noticed.

views.title: Replies
views.text: Your median first reply, how many chats you answered within an hour, how many never got an answer, and how reply speed lines up with closing.

views.title: Timing
views.text: A week-by-time-of-day grid of when buyers write and when you close, so you can see where the two don't meet.

views.title: Products
views.text: What buyers asked about but didn't buy, and the words they used that match nothing in your catalog, with a fix one tap away.

views.title: Buyers
views.text: Your repeat buyers and the ones slipping away, once you have four weeks of history.

views.title: Lost deals
views.text: Every buyer who went quiet, grouped by why, from missed questions to delivery worries.

views.title: Sorting
views.text: How your chats were sorted into sales, business, support and personal, and what buyers asked about over the last eight weeks.

faq.question: Is this a reporting dashboard?
faq.answer: No. It answers three questions: what closed, what slipped and why, and where to act next. Numbers link to the chats or screen where you fix them.

faq.question: How soon does it work?
faq.answer: Today's numbers start straight away. History needs about 20 scored sales chats, a pattern needs at least 3 examples, and the Buyers view needs four weeks of history.

faq.question: Do I get the report by email?
faq.answer: No. Reports live in SellThinker, so they're there whenever you open Insights. The weekly report is ready every Monday morning, and the monthly one on the 1st.

faq.question: Does it show money?
faq.answer: Only as an estimate. Sales are valued at your catalog prices and clearly marked as an estimate, because SellThinker never sees your payments.

faq.question: Who can see Insights?
faq.answer: Owners and admins, plus anyone you give access to.
